title: This must be more than just dreams

meta.initial_emotion: minorly obsessed with the perplexity / surreal and uncanny (re: discovering sub)
meta.author_theory: Mentions possibilities: simulation / collective unconscious / soul prison; believes answers hidden in Mall World.

extraction.extraction_notes: Post describes a long-term recurring shared dreamscape with multiple recurring locations and relative spatial relations (mall->fountain->food court->department store->theatre; mountain->ocean/beach/dockworld; hotel with basement pool; shower portal destinations). Some details (exact lighting, crowding) are only given for certain locations; others left not_mentioned.
